description: Empirically validated causal inflection points where feedback or mechanisms changed subsequent actions

inflection_points.causal_mechanism: Initial prototype baseline establishment using sparse ridge operator and standard neighborhood features.
Primary architectural inflection: adoption of graph topology statistics and neighbor-group feature aggregation, lifting Macro-F1 to 0.7090.

Secondary calibration inflection: probability calibration reduced ECE from 0.0746 to 0.0534 (-28.4%) and average inference latency from 3.54s to 2.71s (-23.4%), while classification Macro-F1 remained flat (0.7088).
Initial greedy layout proposal generation with standard bounding box constraints.

Substantive heuristic shift: initialCutDelta ranks up to 4 anchor-safe proposals by immediate layout cut score before repair, with 25% random bypass. Delivered +3,475,498 native gain and 50/50 test suite pass.
Tight closed-loop evaluation feedback (140 agent / 215 auto evaluations) allowed continuous portfolio weight re-estimation without catastrophic drift.
Dynamic exploration across portfolio volatility regimes under VaR-timing-v1 evaluator with native execution feedback ratcheting progress.
